questions.q: I want to introduce my partner to my friends early on.
questions.ex: A month into dating, I bring them along to dinner with my friends.

questions.q: I've imagined a confession or proposal down to the place and the exact words.
questions.ex: I once decided I'd say it at the top of the Ferris wheel.

questions.q: After a fight, I first want to sort out what actually caused it.
questions.ex: I go back to the start: "Where did this go wrong?"

questions.q: I like to decide where and when we're going on a date ahead of time.
questions.ex: For a Saturday date, the place and meeting time are set by Wednesday.

questions.q: When I like someone, I only talk about it with one person I trust.
questions.ex: I only share my love life with one close friend.

questions.q: I fall for someone only after we've met and talked many times.
questions.ex: It's less love at first sight and more liking a coworker after many chats.

questions.q: After a fight, I want to make up before figuring out why.
questions.ex: Rather than deciding who was wrong, I'd say "Sorry" and get back to normal.

questions.q: If I spot a shop I like on a date, I want to stop by, even if it changes the plan.
questions.ex: On the way to lunch, we walk into a café we just spotted.

questions.q: When I'm interested in someone, I'm the one who goes up and starts talking.
questions.ex: If I like someone, I'm the one who sends the first message.

questions.q: I love talking with my partner about future dreams and "what if" scenarios.
questions.ex: We talk about "If we lived together, which town would we pick?"

questions.q: When my partner comes to me with a problem, I start thinking of solutions first.
questions.ex: While they vent about work, I say "Why not talk to your boss?"

questions.q: I like to agree early on how often we'll keep in touch and on our ground rules.
questions.ex: Right after we start dating, we agree to text before bed.

questions.q: After a date, I want some time alone.
questions.ex: Even after a fun date, I want to unwind by myself at home.

questions.q: For anniversaries, I'd rather go to our usual place than somewhere special.
questions.ex: Even for our one-year anniversary, our usual BBQ place makes me happy.

questions.q: When my partner comes to me with a problem, I start with "I get it."
questions.ex: When they vent about work, I say "That sounds awful" before any advice.

questions.q: I'd rather decide where to go after we meet up.
questions.ex: We meet first, then figure out together "Where should we go?"

INTJ.name: Owl in Love
INTJ.one: You look up the route before a date.
INTJ.desc: You fall for someone slowly, and you rehearse a confession in your head many times first. On date day, you've already checked the way to the restaurant. Your texts are short and to the point, so people think you're cold. But you start choosing anniversary gifts early and take your time.
good: You truly back your partner's dreams
You offer a fix right away
care: Your texts read like work memos
You win fights with pure logic
You hide your jealousy
You plan the future alone
You don't know when to lean in
INTJ.tip: In today's text, add one line after the main point: "I was really happy to see you." That alone says so much.
best: INTP
You both spend weekends apart, then light up over deep talks at night. They add ideas to your plans that you'd never think of.
hard: ISFJ
They feel safe with a daily "good morning" and small kind gestures. If you keep sending short, to-the-point replies, they may hide how lonely they feel.

INTP.name: Cat in Love
INTP.one: You remember the stories your crush tells.
INTP.desc: You secretly check out the books and movies your crush mentions. Yet somehow, your reply comes the next day. Bookstores and museums make the best dates, and late-night calls never seem to end. When they ask, "What do you like about me?" you start a serious analysis, and sweet words come out sounding flat.
good: You never push plans on them
You think hard about their worries
You never raise your voice in a fight
care: Your reply comes the next day
You forget anniversaries
You explain who's right mid-fight
You analyze why you like them
You keep missing the moment to confess
INTP.tip: When something reminds you of them, send one line right then: "Saw this and thought of you." It's fine even before your thoughts are sorted.
best: INTJ
They plan the date, so all you do is enjoy the day. On the walk home, deep talks make you lose track of time.
hard: ISFP
They read feelings through faces and mood. When you go quiet to think, they may worry, "Are you mad at me?"

ENTJ.name: Lion in Love
ENTJ.one: You're the one who confesses first.
ENTJ.desc: When you like someone, you confess first, no hesitation. You book the anniversary dinner early and plan out the whole date. If your partner has a problem, you start fixing it right away. But your texts end the second the business is done. Even on dates, you tend to take charge.
good: You act fast when trouble hits
You don't dodge talk of the future
You're truly proud when they grow
care: Texts end once business is done
You take charge even in love
You set goals for romance too
You rush to a verdict in fights
You can't show weakness
ENTJ.tip: For the next date, let your partner choose just one place. The joy of being trusted stays with them for a long time.
best: ENTP
It's fun when they cut into your plan with, "Wouldn't this be more fun?" You two get closer after every debate.
hard: ESFJ
You both want to run the date plan. You choose by efficiency, they choose by everyone's feelings, so making plans can turn into a clash.

ENTP.name: Fox in Love
ENTP.one: The more you like someone, the more you tease them.
ENTP.desc: The more you like someone, the more you tease them, and even your confession comes out like a joke. Changing plans mid-date with "Actually, let's go there" is just normal for you. Your banter is quick, and you're great at making a down partner laugh. But your replies depend on your mood, and being chased can make you cool off fast.
good: You're never boring to be with
A genius at cheering them up
You make their stories more fun
care: Even your confession sounds like a joke
You change plans mid-date
Your replies depend on your mood
You treat fights like debates
Being chased cools you off
ENTP.tip: When your partner starts a serious talk, hold back one joke and just say, "Yeah, and then?"
best: ENTJ
They actually book the trip you threw out on a whim. Your jokes turn into real memories.
hard: ESFP
They want to take "I like you" straight. Each time you get shy and joke it off, they may feel brushed aside.

INFJ.name: Whale in Love
INFJ.one: You notice the smallest changes in your partner right away.
INFJ.desc: You quickly catch a change in their voice or a reply that's a little off. You reread every text several times before sending. You remember special dates well, and it stings a little when they forget. But you hope they'll sense how you feel without saying it, and when you hit your limit, you may suddenly go silent.
good: You love someone for a long time
care: You reread texts over and over
You go quiet, hoping they'll guess
You notice lies quickly
Your ideal partner bar is very high
You vanish when you hit your limit
INFJ.tip: When you wish they'd just guess, send that feeling in one sentence. Putting it into words gets it across.
best: INFP
On late-night calls, they wait with "And then?" when you start to share what's really on your mind. You feel safe opening up.
hard: ISTJ
They feel safe with the usual place and the usual plan. On nights you want to talk feelings, they may reply, "So, what time tomorrow?" and you end up out of sync.

INFP.name: Hedgehog in Love
INFP.one: You replay one thing they said, again and again.
INFP.desc: When your crush texts, you leave it on read and spend hours thinking up a reply. Around them you freeze up, and on the way home the "I should've said that" review begins. You're too scared of rejection to confess first, so you hope they'll say it. You treasure even small anniversaries. After a fight, you may cry alone, replaying their words.
good: You accept them as they are
Your words come from the heart
care: Stuck on read, unsure what to say
You freeze around your crush
Your daydreams run ahead
Love songs feel personal
You idealize your ex
INFP.tip: When you can't decide how to reply, just send one sticker first. The rest can come later, at your own pace.
best: INFJ
They put your hard-to-say feelings into words: "You mean this?" You can talk for hours in a quiet café.
hard: ISTP
They help with actions, like fixing your bike, more than with talk about feelings. On nights you want to hear "I love you," they may feel distant.

ENFJ.name: Dolphin in Love
ENFJ.one: You're your partner's biggest fan when it comes to their dreams.
ENFJ.desc: You prepare anniversary surprises weeks in advance. When your partner shares a dream, you cheer them on like it's your own. Your texts are always thoughtful, and you get along with their family and friends right away. But you don't want to be disliked, so you apologize first after fights, then later feel, "Why is it always me?"
care: You apologize first after fights
Dates are always their pick
You try to help them "grow"
You even counsel their ex
You expect something back for giving
ENFJ.tip: For the next date, suggest just one place you want to go. It's okay to say, "Will you come with me?"
best: ENFP
They have the most fun on the dates you plan. You hype each other up, and talk of the next trip never stops.
hard: ESTJ
They value decisions and results over feelings. When you want to talk feelings, they reply, "So, what will you do?" and you don't quite click.

ENFP.name: Otter in Love
ENFP.one: Your feelings show on your face right away.
ENFP.desc: You fall for people fast, and it shows right away. When something good happens, you send text after text. Dates are often planned that same morning, and when you spot an interesting shop, you want to pop in. But a little silence makes you anxious fast, and jealousy shows all over your face.
good: You say "I like you" with your whole heart
You enjoy their dreams with them
care: You send text after text
Silence makes you anxious fast
Date plans get made that morning
Jealousy shows all over your face
Being tied down makes you want to run
ENFP.tip: When you feel anxious, before sending another text, try saying just one thing: "I'm a little lonely right now."
best: ENFJ
They turn your spur-of-the-moment "I want to go!" into a plan right away. Your excitement becomes real trips and dates.
hard: ESTP
They want to enjoy the here and now. When you want to talk about the future at night, they brush it off with "Why worry about later?" and you feel lonely.

ISTJ.name: Beaver in Love
ISTJ.one: You always get there before the meeting time.
ISTJ.desc: On dates, your usual restaurant feels the most relaxing. You always arrive 10 minutes early. You're too shy for sweet words, but you show love by keeping your promises. Still, if they say, "Let's go somewhere else instead," you freeze a little inside without showing it.
good: Texts at the same time daily
You do what they ask right away
care: Always the same restaurant
You rarely say "I love you"
Sudden changes make you go quiet
Slow to say sorry after fights
Surprises aren't your thing
ISTJ.tip: On your next date, try one place you've never been. A day that's a little different can become a great memory.
best: ISTP
You plan the weekend, and they add a small detour on a whim. Even with few words, it never feels awkward, and just walking side by side feels calm.
hard: INFJ
They want to talk feelings slowly, like "How do you feel lately?" When you answer with actions, "We meet, and I keep my promises," you can end up talking past each other.

ISFJ.name: Bear in Love
ISFJ.one: You remember the favorite foods of the one you love.
ISFJ.desc: If your partner sneezes, there are throat drops in your bag next time you meet. You remember their favorite drink and the foods they dislike, and you quietly prepare before they ask. "Don't push yourself" is your go-to text. But even on lonely days you reply, "I'm fine," and later sigh alone.
good: You notice when they feel unwell
Bandages and throat drops in your bag
You listen to the very end
care: "I'm fine" hides how you feel
You put your own plans last
You can't choose where to go
You suddenly cry at your limit
You can't throw away keepsakes
ISFJ.tip: Today, when you start typing "I'm fine," add one honest word. Something like "Honestly, I wanted to see you" is enough.
best: ISFP
When they invite you for a spontaneous walk or café, you come along with drinks and a blanket. You both dislike fights, so cozy time at home becomes your favorite.
hard: INTJ
They show love through future plans and efficiency. When they miss the small care you give every day, and your "thank you" never comes, you feel lonely.

ESTJ.name: Elephant in Love
ESTJ.one: You set up every detail of the date, all at once.
ESTJ.desc: Once you decide to date someone, you set the next date, the booking, and the time to head home, right then. Your texts are short and exact: "Sat 11am, station gate." Things just get done when you're around, so your partner relies on you a lot. But when they start sharing feelings after a fight, you rush with, "So, what do you want?"
good: You always do what you say
care: You over-plan every date
You cut in before they finish
Strict about being late
You act fine even when tired
Romantic gestures make you shy
ESTJ.tip: Next time they start talking, listen to the end without cutting in. Before giving an answer, just say, "Oh, I see," once.
best: ESTP
When they say, "Let's go now!" you look up trains and places in a flash. Their whims and your planning click, and dates move at a great pace.
hard: ENFJ
They want to put feelings into words and share them slowly. The more you wrap things up with plans and logic, the more they feel unheard.

ESFJ.name: Penguin in Love
ESFJ.desc: One month, six months, even your first date, it's all in your calendar. You know their favorite foods and their friends' names, and you bake a homemade cake for their birthday. You reply fast and even check on how they're feeling. But when "thank you" doesn't come for days, you quietly start to build up frustration.
good: You make friends with their friends
care: You give until you're worn out
You wait for a "thank you"
You want to know their schedule
You save up complaints, then burst
You worry about what others think
ESFJ.tip: Today, ask them for one thing: "Could you do this for me next time?" Practice receiving, not just giving.
best: ESFP
When they say, "I want to go here!" you make the plan and take lots of photos. Lively, yet built to last.
hard: ENTJ
You both want to plan the dates yourselves. You pick by "Will they be happy?" and they pick by efficiency, so every trip plan becomes a fight over who leads.

ISTP.name: Wolf in Love
ISTP.one: You don't say "I love you," but you quietly help.
ISTP.desc: If your partner says their bike has a flat, you show up with tools, no words needed. Your replies are often just one sticker, yet when they're in trouble, you come help right away. You don't tie them down, so they say being with you feels easy. But when they ask, "How do you feel about me?" the words won't come, and you go quiet.
good: What you say is always true
Leave driving and gadgets to you
care: Texts end with a sticker
You almost never say "I love you"
You go quiet without alone time
You freeze when feelings come up
You leave date plans to them
ISTP.tip: Today, after you help them, add one line: "Because I love you." When they know why you act, they feel much safer.
best: ISTJ
You can follow the date plans they make without worry. You both talk little, so even a quiet drive feels comfortable.
hard: INFP
They want to share feelings in words, taking their time. Your easy "Eh, it's fine" can feel like you're taking their feelings lightly.

ISFP.name: Panda in Love
ISFP.one: You remember the views you saw together, forever.
ISFP.desc: Your date plans are loose, and you love wandering into a café that catches your eye. Instead of saying "I love you," you find a little thing that suits them and give it without a word. When a fight is coming, you laugh and change the subject. And when frustration builds, your replies slowly get later and later.
good: You quietly send photos of views
care: Tight schedules wear you out
You go quiet and slip away in fights
Frustration shows as slow replies
You put off talk of the future
You want to meet on a whim
ISFP.tip: When something bugs you, say one thing that same day. Something short like "That bugged me a little" is fine.
best: ISFJ
When you say on a whim, "Let's try this café," they happily come along. You both dislike arguing, so time together stays calm.
hard: INTP
They like to sort feelings with logic. When you say, "I just didn't like it," they ask "Why?" and you get tired because you can't explain.

ESTP.name: Cheetah in Love
ESTP.one: You're the first to send "Free today?"
ESTP.desc: When you like someone, you text "Wanna grab dinner today?" before you can hesitate. A sudden weekend drive to the sea, a new activity, life with you is never dull. You don't dwell on small things, so after a fight you're fine by the next day. But when the talk turns to "Where is this going?" your replies suddenly get short.
good: You don't carry fights to tomorrow
You show them new ways to have fun
care: You get close too fast
You change the subject when it's heavy
Bored means more left-on-read
Future plans are mostly TBD
You forget promises made on a whim
ESTP.tip: On the way home from a fun date, ask one thing: "How was today for you?" Knowing how they feel makes the next date even better.
best: ESTJ
When you say, "Let's go somewhere," they pick the place and even the time to head home. Your sudden ideas turn into fun memories.
hard: ENFP
They want to slowly talk about future dreams and what your relationship means. The more you say, "As long as now is fun," the lighter your feelings look to them.

ESFP.name: Parakeet in Love
ESFP.one: You bring a small surprise every time you meet.
ESFP.desc: When you fall for someone, you go all in, with matching items and small surprises on date days. Your phone fills with photos after every date, and on the way home you text, "That was so fun!" You show love straight through words and actions, so your partner really feels loved. But if a reply is a little late, you worry, "Did they lose interest?"
good: You text right after a date
care: Slow replies make you anxious
You pack too many plans in
You laugh fights away
You go quiet when the future comes up
Days apart feel very lonely
ESFP.tip: Tonight, spend an evening doing nothing together. When quiet time feels "calm" too, love lasts longer.
best: ESFJ
They remember your fun dates as special days. Fun and security come together, so it lasts.
hard: ENTP
They enjoy bringing debate and mind games into love. When you share, "I was lonely," and get logic back, you can feel left alone.
